About the job
Seeriet Capital is an independent Swiss asset manager with around CHF 14 billion in assets under management, 130 employees and offices in Zurich and Geneva. We are licensed by FINMA as a manager of collective assets under the Financial Institutions Act (FinIA) and manage equity and fixed income funds as well as discretionary mandates for pension funds and family offices.

Our Head of Legal & Compliance will be on extended leave from November. To bridge the period until her return in summer 2027, we are looking for an experienced interim leader who can take over the function from day one.

Your responsibilities
- Lead the Legal & Compliance team of five (two legal counsels, three compliance officers) and report to the CEO and to the Audit & Risk Committee of the Board
- Act as the designated compliance officer towards FINMA and our regulatory audit firm, including the annual compliance risk analysis and the compliance report to the Board
- Oversee anti-money laundering controls under the Swiss AMLA and the FINMA AMLO, including KYC for institutional clients and sanctions screening
- Steer the remediation of the findings from this year's regulatory audit (conflicts of interest, personal account dealing, outsourcing inventory)
- Review and negotiate fund distribution agreements, investment management agreements and service contracts with custodians and fund administrators
- Advise on FinSA client segmentation, product documentation and the revised Federal Act on Data Protection (revFADP)
- Coordinate internal investigations together with external counsel if and when needed

What you bring
- Master of Law and admission to the bar in Switzerland; a German or other EU qualification combined with several years of Swiss practice will also be considered
- At least 15 years of post-qualification experience in legal and compliance roles, of which at least 5 years leading a team, ideally at an asset manager, bank or insurer
- Profound knowledge of Swiss financial market law (FinIA, FinSA, CISA, AMLA) and of the relevant FINMA circulars
- Proven experience in dealing with FINMA and regulatory audit firms
- Fluent German and English; French is a plus given our Geneva office
- Interim management experience is an advantage

Contract details
- Start: 1 November 2026 or by agreement
- Duration: 9 months, until the end of July 2027
- Workload: 100 %
- Location: our office in Zurich (Kreis 1). Due to the regulatory set-up of the function and our internal policies, the role is fully on-site; remote work is not possible.
- Daily rate: CHF 1,450 to 1,600 depending on experience, excluding VAT
- Engagement via our payroll partner or directly with your Swiss company; candidates from the EU/EFTA are welcome, we arrange the Swiss work permit

Please apply with your CV and a short note on your availability. Our HR Business Partner, Nadja Imhof, will get back to you within five working days.
